svg.text: Space zoning and visitor / staff routes
Ground-floor corporate office - Stage II Knitting Apparel Ltd. / Unit-1 / Zara Fashion - Holding 329/2, Ward 15, Vogra, Bason, Gazipur
Interior design proposal - not for construction - all dimensions to be verified on site
Zoning follows the client's office programme, the company profile departments and
the Global Design Studio master plan (studio zones about 1,400 sft).
Visitor route: gate - lobby - reception - passage - experience centre - boardroom
Staff route: gate - staff corridor - offices - hallway - design wing
Executive link: reception - executive suite - boardroom
